plugin.name: Testcontainers Data Sources
plugin.description: Automatically creates Database tool window data sources for containers started by Testcontainers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Redis) and removes them when the container dies. Requires docker CLI in PATH.
plugin.change-notes: Idempotent re-registration after reconnects (no data source blinking or notification spam); persistent ownership marker so reconcile can never remove user data sources (docker id prefixes compared correctly); until-build 262.*; settings page in Settings > Tools; notification when Docker is unavailable; MongoDB support; coroutine-based sync scheduling.
